title: Reading Between the Dots
subtitle: Decoding hidden computation across filler tokens

chapters.title: The question: do the dots do work?
chapters.blurb: A model emits a row of content-free dots before answering — and its accuracy rises. The reported uplift, replotted.

chapters.title: Build the machine, then probe it
chapters.blurb: A real two layer attention toy where the fillers provably carry the computation, read out with a logit lens.

chapters.title: Relay or scenery?
chapters.blurb: Two toys, same answer: ablation and transplant separate load-bearing dots from scenery, exactly as the paper does at scale.

chapters.title: The findings, at their honest size
chapters.blurb: Two open weights frontier models, four task families, and eighty to ninety five percent of hidden intermediates decoded — caveats included.

chapters.title: You can't verify what you can't see
chapters.blurb: Hidden computation versus legible chains of thought: oversight followed trace access, and nothing else.
